content.text:
You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models a tiny state machine over two variables, x and y, with set-valued constraints on the initial state and next-state relation. The key design point is that the next-state action leaves y unchanged while constraining the next value of x to be a subset of y', and the spec also defines predicates checking whether x is the full set {1, 2, 3} and whether element 3 is gained in a transition. It additionally uses the TLC module to inspect named-state exploration metadata through TLCGet and asserts expected counts for the named predicates FullSet and GainThree; there is no fault model, no full temporal Spec operator, and no fairness condition.
